{{Quote|Impressive&hellip;most impressive.|Darth Vader regarding Luke Skywalker jumping during the Duel on Cloud City|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''Force jump''', also known as '''Force leap''', used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to augment the user's natural leaping ability. [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] adept in this [[Force power/Legends|technique]] could perform awe-inspiring vertical/horizontal leaps with impunity.

==Applications==
Using the Force to enhance one's jumping ability was one of the most commonly used Force powers by Force-users throughout [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|history]]. The height to which a user could jump varied depending on skill level and physique; however, most [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] could easily jump several times their own height. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]] was known to have been able to jump up to eight times higher than a normal jump<ref name="JKJA">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref> and a [[Unidentified Jedi (Myles' killer)|Jedi]] during the [[Battle of Galidraan]] was able to jump high enough to reach the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Myles]] who was flying high in the air using a [[Jetpack/Legends|Jetpack]] and cut him in half.<ref name="Open Seasons">''[[Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons]]''</ref> A skilled user could leap tremendous distances when combining this technique with that of the muscle-enhancing [[Force speed/Legends|Force speed]] and perform impossible acrobatic stunts with [[Inertia]].<ref name="JKJA" />

It can be considered a hybrid ability also placing it in the Alter area as [[Telekinesis/Legends|Telekinesis]] is used to conduct abnormal jumps. One example is when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was hanging with his hands just before leaping to slice [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] in half. When jumping down Telekinesis is also coupled when slowing the landing of the jumps in order to make sure the user isn't hurt during the fall. Another example is when [[Mace Windu]] jumps off the balcony on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].
[[File:Force_Jump.jpg|thumb|left|170px|A Jedi using Force Jump to ambush [[stormtrooper]]s.]]
In combat, a well-timed Force Jump enabled the user to quickly cross the distance to engage an enemy;<ref name="KotOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref><ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> this was most widely employed during [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] battles. It was also common for Jedi to use this technique to evade attacks in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], many would use and practice [[sai]] acrobatics which relied on the Force for the jump's power, height, and speed.<ref name="Unifying Force">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref> This ability was essential for practitioners of the acrobatic [[Form IV/Legends|fourth form]] of lightsaber combat,<ref name="JvS" /> such as [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].

At the time of the [[Dark Nest Crisis]], Jedi trainees of the [[New Jedi Order]] at the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|academy]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] practiced their Force Leaps from a young age by jumping over a three-meter cross ray. The [[Woodoos|youngest students]] at the academy would practice this way, with safety [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] to break their fall if they couldn't land on their own.<ref name="Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'', the player suffers from damage when they jump high and then fall again to the ground (for example, whenever they fail to reach the high step they intended to climb). However, in ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]'' this is not the case.<ref name="JKDF">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''</ref>

In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', the [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]] class has a special ability, Force Jump, which allows users to attack an enemy from afar instantly by jumping, plus bonus roll at high level.<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref><ref name="KotOR2" />
